Category: Super Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 10,000eb - 1 Month
Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Melee
Range: Melee
Alt. fire: Renzokuken (See Special Features)

Having moved at least 6m/yds this turn, the user may make a Leaping Strike: 4m/yds forward, half of the weapon's ROF 2, no MOVE spent, 4d6 on a hit. Bring a target to 0 HP or lower and sacred power runs for 9 seconds (3 Rounds), opening the Renzokuken - a ROF 1 attack, never an Aimed Shot, never in a Grapple. Renzokuken: a Melee Weapons check at -4 against the target's Evasion. On a success, roll 3d6 dropping the lowest, then multiply by how much the check beat Evasion, capped at half the user's Melee Weapons Level rounding up. Miss and the user spends an Action next turn recovering before anything else. A landed Renzokuken counts as two Melee Weapon hits toward Martial Arts Special Move prerequisites.

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Super Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
